title: New workspace
description: Set up a separate brand environment. Each workspace owns its own channels, team access, settings, and planning surface.
adminOnly: Only agency admins can create workspaces. Ask your admin to create one and add you to it.
nameHint: The brand name your team and clients will see.
slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens. Used in URLs.
timezonesHint: Used for the calendar, lead-time math, and any 'X days from now' view.
errorExists: A workspace with that slug already exists.
errorSlugInvalid: Slug must be lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens.
